limitations: Rights (C10-Q1, R-599): the IAPWS terms of use for R6-95 were not read (iapws.org refused, 2026-10-22); the rights row is `unresolved`. benchmarks/s05/iapws95_coefficients.json is unpackaged (A26), so `iapws95-v1` runs only from a source checkout; Tables 6-8 are not compared; ADR 0045 remains Proposed. There is no `released` status and no wheel carrying the coefficients until C10-Q1 is answered, and `reviewed` would cover numerics only, not rights.

`iapws95-v1` is library-only (R-568, R-569): it is not in revision_binding.SELECTABLE_BASES, so no revision can select it and no development case becomes runnable (U02); it is registered in the T08 envelope's LIBRARY_ONLY_PROVIDERS and its scanned_providers (spec §8 F-2). Coverage counts are unchanged.

The R6-95(2018) Tables 6-8 are not compared (C10-Q1, spec §10 Q-1): the coefficients and the admitted values equal two independent transcriptions (CoolProp 8.0.0, iapws 1.5.5) and a 50-digit evaluation of the committed transcription; a transcription error shared by both would pass every assertion. This is numerical verification of an implementation against a formulation, not empirical validation (spec §9).

The coefficient file benchmarks/s05/iapws95_coefficients.json is not packaged (R-594, C10-Q1): no PACKAGED entry covers benchmarks/s05/ and a built wheel holds no copy (A26), so `iapws95-v1` runs only from a source checkout.
The near_critical box, T in (647.0, 648.0) K and P in [2.20e7, 2.22e7] Pa, is refused near_critical for both phases and the flash (spec §4.2 step 1); states there are not evaluated.

The saturation band is eps_sigma = 1e-6 in ln(P/p_sigma) (spec §4.2 step 4): both phases are answered inside it, metastable states beyond it are refused phase_not_stable, and a TP flash inside it is refused tp_flash_degenerate.
